title: Throughput-adaptive NDCG/MRR proxy and customer promptset factory
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight, throughput-adaptive scoring proxy and a reusable customer promptset factory so we can run stable, low-latency NDCG/MRR evaluations across production and canary traffic. Goals: (1) decouple scoring/eval path from the hot token-generation path using an async scoring proxy; (2) provide deterministic, reproducible customer promptset generation (sampling seeds, buckets, stratified by customer slice) for evals and A/B hooks; (3) instrument bootstrap CIs for NDCG@5 and MRR@10 and ship Grafana panels and alerting; (4) preserve a 95th %-ile p99 latency budget add of <=25ms for the primary API path while enabling high-throughput offline scoring and live canary checks.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy accepts batched candidate lists and returns ranks with NDCG/MRR compatible scoring payloads
Promptset factory can produce deterministic splits (train/val/canary) per-customer and per-workload with seeds exposed in the API
Integration tests that validate NDCG@5 and MRR@10 calculations match offline reference implementation within 0.001 change
Grafana dashboard with NDCG@5, MRR@10, sample sizes, and bootstrap CI displayed; alert if delta > 0.03 for major customers
End-to-end canary hook: traffic-split to proxy scoring path with 5% rollout and automatic rollback on fail criteria
